controls.columns_shuffled: names shown in random order; regression ignores column order
controls.names_detail: three arms: real, neutral (V01..Vd), moved (real names permuted across variables)

metric_defs.correct: share of true edges whose cause sits in a strictly earlier consensus tier than its effect
metric_defs.contradicted: share of true edges with the effect in a strictly earlier tier
metric_defs.tied: share with both ends in one tier
metric_defs.regression_f1: directed F1 of regressing each variable on variables in earlier tiers (O4/O5)
metric_defs.orient_only: a3_orient_only.json (exploratory, post hoc): data-method adjacencies re-oriented by tiers; F1 and DV-1 precision
